title: Hedged Requests with Failover in an LLM Gateway
signature: def handle_request(client, request, providers, hedge_delay, deadline)  # a generator
hints: Keep a queue of providers still to try and a list of attempts in flight (at most two). Every loop iteration either sends, or waits with the right timeout.

The timeout is the earlier of the deadline and, when exactly one attempt is in flight and providers remain, that attempt's start + hedge_delay. Measure the hedge timer from the attempt in flight, not from the start of the request.
When wait_any returns an error, drop that attempt. If nothing is left in flight, fail over right away. Don't wait for the hedge timer.
On the first success, cancel every other attempt still in flight. On the deadline, cancel everything. A loser you forget keeps running and gets billed.
